en-US.description: Play your full Athan recording for Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, or Isha. Create a separate Alexa Routine for each prayer, then edit its name and time in the Alexa app as prayer times change. Times are entered manually and do not update automatically.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my athan to play athan
Alexa, ask my athan to play fajr
en-US.name: My Athan

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Configure AUDIO_URL in lambda/index.js with a permanent direct HTTPS audio URL. Deploy and build the en-US model, then enable Development testing. On an Echo test launch, named prayer commands (including fajar, zuhur, asar, and magrib), pause, resume, stop, and a full recording. Test five manually created Alexa Routines; rename one and edit its scheduled time in the Alexa app. Confirm prayer-settings requests explain the app controls without claiming to change or calculate a schedule. No audio recording is included.
